questions.q: Starting from the Administrator and Platform App Builder foundation, what does the lesson say comes next on the way toward CTA?
options: A Developer credential, then the Architect domain credentials, then the Application Architect and System Architect milestones
CTA is awarded immediately after Platform App Builder
There is no further credential path after the foundation
A single combined exam covering everything at once
questions.explain: The lesson lays out the sequence as Developer, then Architect domain credentials, then the Architect milestones, before the CTA review board.

questions.q: Why does the lesson describe CTA as a "destination" rather than something a course alone can deliver?
options: Because CTA has been discontinued by Salesforce
Because CTA is only available to Salesforce employees
Because it additionally requires judgment built from real production experience over real years on the job, not just completed coursework
Because the credential no longer exists in any form
questions.explain: The lesson explains that CTA requires real-world architectural judgment, which a curriculum alone cannot substitute for.

questions.q: According to the lesson, what does completing this lesson mean for the student?
options: Only this single course is complete, with several Administrator-path courses still remaining
Nothing has actually been completed yet
Only the certification exams are complete, with no further coursework involved
The entire Salesforce Administrator path -- Foundations, Administration, Declarative Development, the capstone, and this career-prep course -- is now complete
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly states this is the last lesson of the entire Salesforce Administrator path, not just this course.

questions.q: What does the lesson say the Salesforce Administrator path forks into from this point?
options: Salesforce Data Architect and Salesforce Marketing Cloud, as two separate destinations
One destination, Salesforce Architect, which forks into a Data & Analytics Architect ladder and a Technical Architect ladder
Salesforce Technical Architect and Oracle Financial Applications
There is only one direction, with no fork at all
questions.explain: The lesson names the single destination the catalog's own path map shows branching from the Salesforce Administrator path: Salesforce Architect, which forks into two converging ladders rather than two separate destinations.

questions.q: How does the lesson frame the choice between the two ladders?
options: Neither is "better" -- the choice depends on which kind of work (analytics vs. architecture/security/automation) energized the student most in this path
One ladder is objectively more advanced and should always be chosen
The choice must be made before starting this course, not after
Both ladders lead to the exact same courses regardless of choice
questions.explain: The lesson frames the decision as a matter of fit based on what the student enjoyed most, not a ranking of which ladder is superior.
